reference_conditions.commercial_volume_basis: whole source enclosed air volume with source multipliers, including interior/plenum spaces
reference_conditions.commercial_averaging: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative hourly source correlation volume flows over full EPW year; no design days or timestep interpolation

evidence.original_unit: WSF dimensionless; temperature K; weather-file wind m/s and m2/s2
evidence.transformation: Pinned station lookup or WSF calculation; arithmetic means of abs(22C-db), weather wind and squared weather wind. No zone-height wind conversion.
evidence.interpretation_note: F1 accepted 2013 reference forcing across vintages; WSF used for residential only. Weather filename is provenance, not an applicability axis. Raw candidate receipt remains unchanged.

commercial_reference_benchmarks.original_unit: Native flow per area m3/s/m2; coefficient a dimensionless, b 1/K, d s2/m2; volume m3
commercial_reference_benchmarks.transformation: Sum [native q4/exterior-area * space Outdoors gross area * multiplier * mean(max(0,a+b*abs(22C-height-adjusted EPW dry bulb)+d*height-adjusted wind^2))] / whole source enclosed volume with multipliers
commercial_reference_benchmarks.interpretation_note: Equal-weight hourly EPW samples; schedule=1 for source off correlation, no pressurization/door operation. Includes all source enclosure spaces in denominator, not conditioned-volume claim. No simulation timestep/energy parity claimed.
